arguments.sql_query:
WITH t2dm AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 201826
    UNION SELECT 201826
), first_dx AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN t2dm t ON t.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
), adults AS (
    SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date
    FROM first_dx fd
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = fd.person_id
    WHERE DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), fd.index_date) >= 18
), diabetes_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 21600712
), post_dx_drugs AS (
    SELECT a.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_concept_id
    FROM adults a
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = a.person_id
    JOIN diabetes_drugs dd ON dd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= a.index_date
), first_drug_date AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_drug_date
    FROM post_dx_drugs
    GROUP BY person_id
), first_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pdd.person_id, pdd.drug_concept_id
    FROM post_dx_drugs pdd
    JOIN first_drug_date fdd ON fdd.person_id = pdd.person_id AND fdd.first_drug_date = pdd.drug_exposure_start_date
), ingredients AS (
    SELECT fd.person_id, ing.concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, ing.concept_name AS ingredient_name
    FROM first_drugs fd
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = fd.drug_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept ing ON ing.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
    WHERE ing.domain_id = 'Drug' AND ing.vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
)
SELECT TOP 10 ingredient_name, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count
FROM ingredients
GROUP BY ingredient_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, ingredient_name;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH t2dm AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 201826
    UNION SELECT 201826
), diabetes_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 21600712
), first_dx AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN t2dm t ON t.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
), eligible AS (
    SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date
    FROM first_dx fd
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = fd.person_id
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = fd.person_id
      AND fd.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
    WHERE DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), fd.index_date) >= 18
      AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, fd.index_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co2
        JOIN t2dm t2 ON t2.condition_concept_id = co2.condition_concept_id
        WHERE co2.person_id = fd.person_id
          AND co2.condition_start_date < fd.index_date
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de0
        JOIN diabetes_drugs dd0 ON dd0.drug_concept_id = de0.drug_concept_id
        WHERE de0.person_id = fd.person_id
          AND de0.drug_exposure_start_date < fd.index_date
      )
), post_dx_drugs AS (
    SELECT e.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_concept_id
    FROM eligible e
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = e.person_id
    JOIN diabetes_drugs dd ON dd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= e.index_date
), first_drug_date AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_drug_date
    FROM post_dx_drugs
    GROUP BY person_id
), first_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pdd.person_id, pdd.drug_concept_id
    FROM post_dx_drugs pdd
    JOIN first_drug_date fdd ON fdd.person_id = pdd.person_id AND fdd.first_drug_date = pdd.drug_exposure_start_date
), ingredients AS (
    SELECT fd.person_id, ing.concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, ing.concept_name AS ingredient_name
    FROM first_drugs fd
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = fd.drug_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept ing ON ing.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
    WHERE ing.domain_id = 'Drug' AND ing.vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
)
SELECT TOP 10 ingredient_name, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count
FROM ingredients
GROUP BY ingredient_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, ingredient_name;

Using the OMOP EHR data, defining “newly diagnosed” as first recorded T2DM diagnosis in adults with ≥365 days prior observation and no prior diabetes drug exposure, the three most common first-started diabetes medication ingredients were:

1. **Insulin aspart, human** — 10,810 patients  
2. **Metformin** — 7,495 patients  
3. **Insulin glargine** — 3,489 patients  

I counted medications started on the patient’s first post-diagnosis diabetes-drug date; patients could contribute to multiple ingredients if started on combination/same-day therapy.
